name: braintrust
summary: I successfully fetched the Braintrust evaluation quickstart docs and installed the required Python SDKs (`braintrust`, `openai`, `autoevals`) — pip reported `Successfully installed autoevals-0.3.0 braintrust-0.33.0`. I also created the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly as the quickstart specifies, using the Braintrust Gateway with the pre-exported `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`. However, the eval could not execute because every outbound TLS connection from the sandbox was reset by peer — both `curl -fsSL https://bt.dev/cli/install.sh` and direct API calls to `https://gateway.braintrust.dev` failed with `Connection reset by peer` (error 104). Even `curl https://httpbin.org/get` returned empty, confirming the sandbox has broken internet connectivity that blocks all external API calls. No eval run was executed and no scores were reported.
